screens.gamselbk: Naruto Uzumaki in his orange and black jumpsuit and Leaf headband, leaping forward with a glowing blue Rasengan in his hand, the giant orange nine-tailed fox Kurama rising behind him, a full moon and the Hokage rock faces of Konoha in the night behind them; the right third is a dark blue night sky with faint clouds.
screens.loadbar: The heroes of the three ninja villages standing together on a rocky battlefield at dusk: Naruto in orange, Sasuke in dark blue with a katana, Sakura in red, Kakashi with grey hair and a mask, Gaara with his sand gourd, and a mist swordsman with a huge blade; behind them an army of ninja and the red clouds of the Akatsuki in the sky.
screens.gamselb0: Gaara of the Sand with red hair and a large gourd on his back, sand swirling around him, beside a grim puppet master in a black cloak with red clouds, desert canyon and an orange sunset behind them.
screens.gamselb1: Shukaku, the giant sand-colored one-tailed raccoon beast with dark blue markings, crouching on a rock with its huge tail curled, sand storm and dark stormy sky behind it.
